text: {"title":"Error Rate by Route","timeRange":{"from":"now-24h","to":"now"},"refreshIntervalMs":15000,"panels":[{"id":"error-rate-by-route","title":"Error Rate by Route","description":"Per-second rate of error-level log lines from the api app, grouped by the route field parsed from each line, in errors per second.","viz":"line","format":"number","query":{"sourceId":"eval-loki-demo","logql":"sum by (route) (rate({app=\"api\", level=\"error\"} | json [5m]))"},"options":{"decimals":2,"unit":"err/s","legend":"bottom"},"layout":{"x":0,"y":0,"w":6,"h":4}},{"id":"error-ratio-by-route","title":"Error Ratio by Route","description":"Fraction of api log lines that are at error level, grouped by the parsed route field, over the trailing hour, expressed as a percentage.","viz":"bar","format":"percent","query":{"sourceId":"eval-loki-demo","logql":"sum by (route) (count_over_time({app=\"api\", level=\"error\"} | json [1h])) / sum by (route) (count_over_time({app=\"api\"} | json [1h]))","instant":true},"options":{"decimals":2,"legend":"none"},"layout":{"x":6,"y":0,"w":6,"h":4}},{"id":"recent-error-lines","title":"Recent Error Lines (api)","description":"The most recent error-level log lines from the api app, shown newest first with their parsed route context.","viz":"logs","query":{"sourceId":"eval-loki-demo","logql":"{app=\"api\", level=\"error\"}"},"options":{"level":"level","limit":200,"order":"newest","showTime":true,"wrap":true},"layout":{"x":0,"y":4,"w":12,"h":5}}]}
